dct_title_s: Geodata of Land Cover Classification of Galangan & Katingan, Central Kalimantan, Indonesia
dct_description_sm: This map illustrates a land cover classification of the Galangan site and Katingan catchment area in Central Kalimantan Province, Indonesia. It is derived from Landsat-8 multispectral imagery acquired on 24 September 2014 at 30 meter pixel resolution. The classification is divided into seven main classes: dense vegetation/forest, shrub/disturbed forest, agricultural areas, water, exposed sands/mining, affected waters/mining pits, and exposed soils. The inset table summarizes the total area for each class in the region analyzed. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.
